notes.title: "The Luminous Underground" is a Nebula Finalist! 💫
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that [i]The Luminous Underground[/i], by Phoebe Barton, is a finalist for the [url=https://nebulas.sfwa.org/sfwa-announces-the-56th-annual-nebula-award-finalists/]Nebula Game Writing Award[/url] - and it’s on sale 30% off this week!

[i]The Luminous Underground[/i] is a 660,000-word interactive secondary-world science fantasy novel. Blast spirits out of a haunted subway system! Can your team defeat rival exterminators, shoddy gear, and City Hall?

This is the third year that there has been a Nebula award for game writing, and the third year that Choice of Games authors have been finalists. Past Choice of Games Nebula finalists are: Kate Heartfield for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/849560/The_Road_to_Canterbury/]The Road to Canterbury[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1174830/The_Magicians_Workshop/]The Magician’s Workshop[/url], Natalia Theodoridou for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/858780/RentaVice/]Rent-a-Vice[/url], and M. Darusha Wehm for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/952010/The_Martian_Job/]The Martian Job[/url].

Since 1965, the Nebula Awards have been given annually to the best works of science fiction and fantasy published that year, as voted on by the members of the Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers of America (SFWA). The 56th Annual Nebula Awards ceremony will be streamed live during the 2021 Nebula Conference Online, June 4-6, 2021. Stay tuned for more!
